name: Find the Shattered Hand
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
You have served the Deathstalkers well, adventurer, but perhaps it is time for you to venture outward. While you have shown aptitude in the ways of stealth and deception, you still require much training.

The Deathstalkers have allies within the Shattered Hand. Seek out those that would assist us - find Shenthul in Orgrimmar.
narrative.objectives: Journey to Orgrimmar and speak with Shenthul at the Cleft of Shadow.
narrative.offerRewardText: So, you are what our mighty allies have sent Shenthul? How uninspiring....
